description: Pronunciation practice words. Phonemes use ARPAbet (scoring) and broad IPA (display).

sources.us_pronunciations: CMU Pronouncing Dictionary (BSD-2-Clause) with manual overrides
sources.gb_pronunciations: espeak-ng en-gb phonemizer (converted to ARPAbet), with manual overrides
sources.reference_audio: Human recording in data/reference_audio/<word>.wav if present, otherwise neural TTS (Piper) synthesised from each variant's phonemes, otherwise espeak-ng/browser TTS.
